title: Terms of Use

sections.heading: 1. Scope and Acceptance
sections.text: By using KaymakTV (the "App") you accept these Terms of Use and the Community Guidelines. How your personal data is processed is explained separately in the Privacy Policy. If you do not accept them, do not use the App. The App is not designed for children under 13; if you are under 13, do not create an account.

sections.heading: 2. Third-Party Services and Data Accuracy
sections.text: TV show and movie information and images come from third-party services such as Trakt and TMDB. KaymakTV does not guarantee that this data is accurate, up to date or always available, and is not responsible for outages or data loss in third-party services. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

sections.heading: 3. User Content
sections.text: You are responsible for the comments, reviews, posts, notes and profile details (name, bio, photo) you share. The Community Guidelines say what is not allowed; you must accept them before you can share content. Content that breaks the guidelines may be hidden or removed, and accounts that break them may be suspended temporarily or closed permanently. You can report any content or user from inside the app and block any user you do not want to see. Under Turkish Law No. 5651 KaymakTV is a "hosting provider": it has no obligation to review user content in advance, and it reviews content that is reported.

sections.heading: 4. Privacy
sections.text: The Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, why we use it, who we share it with and how you can have it deleted. We never see or store your password: sign-in happens on Google's or Trakt's own page.

sections.heading: 5. Account Security
sections.text: Keeping your device secure and preventing unauthorized access to your account is your responsibility. KaymakTV is not responsible for changes caused by unauthorized access to your Google, Trakt or other connected accounts.

sections.heading: 6. Intellectual Property
sections.text: The App's interface, brand identity, logo and original software belong to its developer. Posters and TV show and movie information are subject to the rights of their providers (TMDB, Trakt) and rights holders. You keep the rights to the content you share; by sharing it, you grant us a free, non-exclusive license to host it on the App and kaymaktv.com, back it up and show it to other users until you delete it.

sections.heading: 7. Disclaimer
sections.text: The App is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, the developer is not liable for any direct or indirect damage arising from use of the App. KaymakTV reserves the right to change, suspend or discontinue the service or any of its features without prior notice. These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye.

sections.heading: 8. Changes
sections.text: These terms may be updated. The current text is always published in the App and at kaymaktv.com. When the Community Guidelines change, you will be asked to accept the new guidelines before you continue sharing content.

sections.heading: 9. Contact
sections.text: For questions, complaints and appeals: destek@kaymaktv.com

privacySections.heading: 1. What this policy covers
privacySections.text: This policy explains what data is collected when you use the KaymakTV mobile app and the kaymaktv.com website, why it is used, who it is shared with and how you can have your data deleted. The data controller is the developer of KaymakTV. Contact: destek@kaymaktv.com

privacySections.heading: 2. Data we collect
privacySections.text:
Account: when you sign in with Google, your Google account ID, your name (to derive your first username) and the address of your profile photo. Your email address is processed only during sign-in, for verification and to show it on the account selection screen; it is not stored on our servers. When you sign in with Trakt, your Trakt username and ID; the access keys we need to reach your Trakt account on your behalf are stored encrypted on our server. We never see your password.

Profile: your username, display name, bio, the address of your profile photo and your privacy settings.

Watch data: the episodes and movies you watched, your ratings, your watchlist, your favorites and the titles you hid. If you connect your Trakt account, your Trakt history is imported as well.

What you share: your posts, reviews, notes, comments and likes.

Social connections: who you follow, your followers, your follow requests and the users you blocked.

Notifications: your device's notification token and platform (Android, iOS or web), so we can send you notifications.

Reports: when you report content or a profile, what you reported, the reason you chose and the explanation you wrote.

Feedback and diagnostics: the message you write to us, your operating system version and app version; and, only if you allow it, the error logs and performance summary from your device. If the app hits an unexpected error, the error message, platform and app version are sent automatically with a random installation ID that is not linked to your account.

Technical data: your IP address is used momentarily for rate limiting to prevent abuse and may be processed in our infrastructure providers' logs.

privacySections.heading: 3. Data we do not collect
privacySections.text: We do not use your location, contacts, photos, microphone or camera. We do not collect an advertising ID. The app has no ads. We do not sell your data.

privacySections.heading: 4. Why we use the data
privacySections.text: To create your account and keep you signed in; to sync your watch history, lists and ratings across your devices; to run the feed, comments and follow features; to send new-episode and interaction notifications; to review reports and enforce the Community Guidelines; to find and fix errors and prevent abuse.

privacySections.heading: 5. What other users can see
privacySections.text: Your username, display name, profile photo and bio are visible to other users. The posts, reviews and comments you share are public. If you make your account private, only followers you approve can see your watch activity. In Settings you can separately turn off sharing what you watch and what you rate to the feed.

privacySections.heading: 6. Services that process the data
privacySections.text:
Your data is processed through the following service providers; their servers may be outside Türkiye:

Supabase: database (your account, watch data and shared content are stored here).
Cloudflare: the app's server side and network security.
Google: Google sign-in and delivery of Android notifications.
Expo: delivery of notifications to your device.
Trakt: if you connect your account, your watch, rating and list actions are also written to and read from your Trakt account.
TMDB: TV show and movie information and images. Images load directly from TMDB's servers, so TMDB can see your IP address.
Discord: feedback, automatic error reports and new-report alerts are delivered to the developer's private channel. The text of reported content is not sent to Discord.
YouTube: if you open a trailer you are taken to YouTube.

Only the data these services need to do their job is passed to them. We do not share your data with anyone else unless the law requires it.

privacySections.heading: 7. How long we keep it
privacySections.text: Your data is kept for as long as your account is open. When you delete your account, your account, watch data, shared content, comments, follow connections, notification tokens and stored Trakt access keys are permanently deleted. Old activity records in the feed are cleaned up regularly. Feedback you sent is kept under a random ID that is not linked to your account and is not removed by account deletion; write to us if you want it deleted. Data may remain in our providers' backups for a limited time. Moderation action records (which action was taken, when and why) may be kept after your account is deleted for security, abuse prevention and legal obligations; your account link is removed from these records.

privacySections.heading: 8. Your rights and deleting your account
privacySections.text: You can delete your account and data in the app under Settings > Account Options > Delete Account, or at kaymaktv.com/hesap-sil. To access, correct or delete your data, or to object to its processing, write to destek@kaymaktv.com. You can exercise your rights under Turkish Law No. 6698 (KVKK) and, where it applies, the GDPR through this address.

privacySections.heading: 9. Children
privacySections.text: KaymakTV is not designed for children under 13 and does not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If we learn that someone under 13 has created an account, we delete it; if you notice such a case, write to us.

privacySections.heading: 10. Security
privacySections.text: Data is transmitted over an encrypted connection (HTTPS). Access rules in the database ensure each user can reach only the data they are allowed to see; Trakt access keys are stored encrypted. No system is completely secure; if you notice a security problem, write to us.

privacySections.heading: 11. Changes
privacySections.text: This policy may be updated. The current text is always published in the App and at kaymaktv.com/gizlilik.

rulesSections.heading: 1. Why there are guidelines
rulesSections.text: KaymakTV is a place for people who want to talk about what they watch. These guidelines apply to posts, reviews, notes, comments and your profile details (name, username, photo, bio). You must accept them before you can share content.

rulesSections.heading: 2. Content and behavior that is not allowed
rulesSections.text:
• Harassment, bullying, threats and targeting a person.
• Hate speech: demeaning people or inciting violence because of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability or similar characteristics.
• Sexual content, nudity, child sexual abuse and exploitation (CSAE) or any content that sexualizes minors (zero tolerance).
• Content that encourages or glorifies violence; encouraging self-harm.
• Illegal content and directing people to illegal activity; links to pirated streams.
• Spam, advertising, scams and misleading links.
• Impersonating another person or organization.
• Sharing someone else's personal information without permission.
• Sharing someone else's content without the rights holder's permission.

rulesSections.heading: 3. Spoilers
rulesSections.text: Mark anything that reveals the plot of a title as "contains spoilers". Unmarked spoilers can be reported and hidden.

rulesSections.heading: 4. Reporting and blocking
rulesSections.text: You can send us any post, review, comment or profile that breaks the guidelines with "Report" in its menu. You can block a user you do not want to see from the same menu; a blocked user cannot interact with you and their content is not shown to you. You can manage the users you blocked in Settings.

rulesSections.heading: 5. What happens when the guidelines are broken
rulesSections.text: We review reports promptly. If content is reported by several users it may be hidden automatically until the review is finished. Depending on how serious and how repeated the violation is, content may be hidden or removed and the account may be suspended temporarily or closed permanently. A suspended account cannot share content, but can still access its data and delete the account.

rulesSections.heading: 6. Appeals
rulesSections.text: If you think a decision was wrong, write to destek@kaymaktv.com with your username and we will review it again.

rulesSections.heading: 7. Changes
rulesSections.text: The guidelines may be updated. When they are, you will be asked to accept the new guidelines before you continue sharing content.

rulesAcceptIntro: A quick word before you share: be respectful, mark spoilers, don't harass anyone. Content that breaks the guidelines can be hidden and accounts can be suspended.
rulesAcceptError: Could not save your acceptance. Check your connection and try again.
rulesAcceptOutdated: The guidelines were updated. Update the app and try again.
rulesAcceptRequired: You need to accept the Community Guidelines to share.

suspendedClosed: Your account has been closed to content sharing for breaking the Community Guidelines. You cannot write posts, reviews or comments, or change your profile text. You can still mark what you watch, access your data and delete your account. To appeal: {{adres}}
deleteAccountHowText:
1) Use the "Sign In" button below and sign in the same way you created your account (Google or Trakt).
2) Go to the Settings screen.
3) Under "Account Options" tap "Delete Account" and confirm.

If you cannot sign in, write to destek@kaymaktv.com with your username and we will delete the account for you.
deleteAccountWhatText: Your KaymakTV account and everything linked to it is permanently deleted: your profile details, watch history, ratings, watchlist and favorites, your posts, reviews and comments, your likes, follow connections, notification tokens and the Trakt access keys stored on our server. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccountWhatNotText: Your Google account and (if you connected it) your Trakt.tv account are not touched; KaymakTV cannot delete those accounts. If you want to delete your history on Trakt, do that separately on trakt.tv. Feedback you sent is kept under a random ID that is not linked to your account, so account deletion does not remove it; write to us if you want it deleted. Moderation action records (which action was taken, when and why) may be kept after your account is deleted for security, abuse prevention and legal obligations; your account link is removed from these records.
deleteAccountFootnote: You don't need to install the app — this can be done from a browser too.
